title: Public JD speaks the role's posting languages; hreflang offers only what ships
tests_added: app/jds/[slug]/jdPublicHeader.test.ts (first case rewritten to the served-set contract)
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: archived JD returns explicit {canonical:'/jds/<slug>', languages:{}} (never undefined) so app/layout.tsx's four ./?lang= alternates are overridden; generateMetadata takes searchParams and keeps owner from loadPublicJd (source-pinned in case 5). Tests + code landed in ONE feat commit (a test-only commit would be red: the module is new); catalogs and doc each committed alone under the lock. Source language = postingSourceLang(getRoleOpenConfig(jobId, owner).postingLangs), imported from job-translate-run.ts so it is stated once (adds 8 modules / 61 KB to the unbudgeted /jds/[slug] page graph; no budgeted entry reaches it). Canonical for the source variant: ?lang=<src> is self-canonical, bare path and unserved ?lang= canonicalise to the bare path. JdBody gains an optional lang prop (set only on a translated body).
notes: tsc: whole-tree red only on sibling A's in-flight app/_lib/db/jobs-browse.test.ts + app/features/library/jobs/useJobsList.test.ts and untracked kpi-sim/; none on my paths. test:unit exit 1 on ONE file, app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts ('an aborted spawn kills the whole process tree'), also red run alone; untouched by this card (process-tree kill on a loaded shared box) — re-check at loop end. test:perf exit 1: 42 app/api/** overages, all from sibling A's UNCOMMITTED app/_lib/db/jobs.ts (+ contract-constants.generated.ts); nothing outside app/jds/ imports my files and app/jds/[slug]/page.tsx has no ceiling, so my measured share is 0 and no ceiling was raised. Nuance recorded in the doc: job_translations holds a translation of the rendered POSTING (renderPostingMarkdown over the job fields), not of the JD markdown, so a translated variant's structure can differ from the original; the MT note links the authoritative original. The stored translation title is the source job title (runPostingTranslation saves job.title). E2E to re-run at loop end (could not run here): e2e/shell.spec.ts (root hreflang alternates — unchanged for non-JD routes) and e2e/public-pages.spec.ts (axe) plus a manual/axe look at /jds/<slug>?lang=cs with a stored translation (new role=note disclosure, NOTICE('info')). Internal ids stay off the wire: the page sees only {lang, sourceLang, title, bodyMd}.
